svg.title: Illustrative UI test of the Foundry Agent Lab with mocked APIs
svg.desc: Four illustrative screenshots from browser tests with mocked APIs: Explore demos, Create agent, Chat with its shared-data notice, and the Document reviews form explaining shared storage before saving. Nothing was published, sent, or saved; these are not live model results.
